# Golden Slipper Modern Boot Repair

> Boot & shoe repair based in Austin, Texas. Heels, half soles and resoles for boots and shoes, plus straps for luggage and bags, and a wall of used boots for sale. Walk in on South 1st, Monday to Friday.

- Phone: (512) 442-6334
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Sunset Valley, West Lake Hills, Rollingwood, Buda
- Google rating: 4.2 from 102 reviews
- Request a quote: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/shoe-repair/texas/golden-slipper-modern-boot-repair/quote.html
- Book a visit: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/shoe-repair/texas/golden-slipper-modern-boot-repair/book.html

## Services
- Boot heels: Worn-down or broken heels rebuilt and replaced on cowboy and western boots, exotics included.
- Soles & resoles: Half soles and full resoles so a favorite pair gets another run instead of the trash.
- Shoe repair: Everyday shoes, dress shoes and heels brought back into good shape.
- Exotic boot care: Ostrich and other exotic-skin boots handled with care, from heel work to a fresh shine.
- Luggage & bag straps: Bands that slip over suitcase handles, extra shoulder straps for a rolling laptop case: creative, custom fixes.
- Used boots for sale: A whole wall of used cowboy boots and shoes. Reviewers walk out with two pairs at a time.

## About
Golden Slipper Modern Boot Repair sits at 1903 S 1st St in South Austin, under a lit roadside sign with a cowboy boot on one side and a high heel on the other. Look for the red door and the yellow 'Shoe & Boot Repair' lettering in the window, on the same strip as the locksmith and Turntable Records. Inside it's a real boot shop: shelves of used cowboy boots floor to ceiling, polish on the rack, and repairs lined up on the bench. Heels, half soles, resoles, exotic boots, and the odd job most shops won't touch, like a strap that slips over a suitcase handle. Customers come back for the same reasons: a favorite pair brought back instead of replaced, creative fixes, and a good pair of used boots at a fair price.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: No. Walk in Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 6 PM, at 1903 S 1st St. If you want to check first, call (512) 442-6334.
- Q: Do you work on exotic boots?
  A: Yes. Ostrich and other exotic-skin boots come through the shop for heels, soles and care. Bring them in and we'll take a look.
- Q: Can you replace just the heel or a half sole?
  A: Yes. Heel rebuilds, top lifts and half soles (like Goodyear Neolite) are everyday work here, along with full resoles.
- Q: Do you sell boots?
  A: Yes. There's a whole wall of used cowboy boots and shoes for sale, and the stock changes all the time.
- Q: Can you fix bags and luggage straps?
  A: Yes. Reviewers have had bands made to slip over suitcase handles and extra shoulder straps added to a rolling computer case.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 1903 S 1st St, Suite B, in Bouldin. Look for the lit sign and the red door.
